lines.text: Flight Night in the forest, friends! Two rounds, two dunks each, five judges on the log, and tonight's rival is waiting in the ferns.
Ha, the treehouse is packed, friends! It's Flight Night: two rounds, two dunks apiece, five judges watching, and a rival who wants it too.
Light through the leaves, hoop in the clearing, Flight Night is on! Two rounds, two dunks each. Five judges. One rival. Let's fly.
Back in the woods for another Flight Night! The birds remember you.
Ha, couldn't stay away from the canopy, huh? Another Flight Night it is.
The forest saved your spot, friend. Another Flight Night, here we go.
Tonight's rival just stepped out of the trees, and they came ready.
Say hello to tonight's rival! The forest has heard stories. Let's see if they're true.
Here comes Cass! Steady as an old oak. Same tomahawk, same landing, every single time.
Ty is in the woods tonight! Quiet, then thunder. Shakes every branch on the way down.
Pilot's here. Quiet as an owl, reads the whole forest, then swoops in.
Oh, it's Zo! Glows like a firefly for the phones. Here for the highlight, friends.
Stack is here! Climbs the tallest tree first, figures out the way down later. Ha!
Your turn, friend. The forest is listening.
Alright, the clearing's all yours. Go climb.
Here we go. Birds, hush up a second.
Step up. The light's on you.
Quiet now... this one's up.
Shake it off. Same tree, one more climb.
Ha, the hoop's still there. Go again.
No worries. Run it back.
Easy. Roots first, then branches. Again.
Last climb, friend. Make it count.
Third try. Even the owls are watching.
One more shot at this. Quiet, everybody.
Here it comes...
Go get it!
Up, up...
Climb, friend!
Wind's up!
Right down the trunk, nice and calm.
Clean, simple, no complaints from me.
Smooth as a river stone.
Solid roots on that one.
There it is, snug as a bird's nest.
Easy breeze, easy points.
Ooh, now the leaves are rustling!
Ha, the judges almost fell off the log!
Floated like a leaf on that one!
Branches are shaking now, friends!
Wind's picking up in the treetops!
Good stuff, that's the good stuff!
Now we're climbing!
Somebody woke up the owls with that one!
Oh my goodness! The whole forest woke up!
Are you serious?! There go the birds!
Get up, treehouse! Get up, get up!
Call the rangers, that was wild!
Unreal! Leaves are still falling from that!
Ha! Even the squirrels are clapping!
No way! That came from the top branch!
Lightning through the leaves!
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Up with the eagles!
Every nest in the canopy just shook!
Fifty! Perfect fifty! Ha, the birds are singing it!
All five judges, tens right across the log!
Oh, a perfect fifty! The old oak tips its branches!
Five tens! I'm hugging a tree right now, friends!
Ooh, the judges saw that one already tonight.
Ha, same tree, same branch. The panel noticed.
We've climbed that trail already tonight. Mix it up.
Pretty, but we've seen that leaf fall already.
Ha, fell short of the top branch.
Ooh, slipped right through the branches.
Nope, the forest wasn't ready.
Whoa, easy! Wind took that one.
Oh, the squirrels really wanted that one.
Missed, but I love the ambition.
Knock on wood... and out it comes.
Ooh, the woodpecker's back on that rim!
Rattled around like an acorn in a can.
Ha, that lob flew off with the birds.
Toss got caught in the wind.
Oh, the ball went exploring without you.
Ooh, brushed it like a low branch!
Ha, tagged the obstacle. It's fine, it's fine.
Clipped it! So close to clean.
Out of climbs. That one goes down as a miss.
No more tries. The judges log it as a miss.
That tree didn't want climbing tonight. It's a miss.
Over to the log!
Log bench is thinking...
Let's hear the panel.
Cards up, judges!
Rival's turn. Let's see what grows.
Now the rival steps into the light.
Cass is up. Steady, steady, steady.
Here comes Ty. Hear that thunder rolling?
Pilot's up, reading the wind like an owl.
Zo's up! Phones out, fireflies!
Stack's up. Somebody spot this one, please.
Oh, nice climb from the other side...
Ha, fair enough. That one grew some roots.
Treehouse nods for that one...
Whoa, the other side can fly too!
Cass, steady as that old oak...
Ty brought the thunder, as promised!
Pilot read it, then swooped!
Zo, glowing for the phones!
Stack went out on the thinnest branch!
Ha, the rival slipped off the branch!
Ooh, there's a gap in the trees, friend!
Missed! The forest giggled a little.
Nope! That one stayed up in the trees.
Well, well. Even oaks drop acorns.
Round two, friends! Final round. This is where the roots show.
Final round under the canopy! Everybody grab a branch.
Here comes round two. Last climb of the night.
You need a big one now. Top branch or nothing.
Behind, but the forest believes. Go shake every leaf out there.
Ha, the rival's got the lead. Time to wake the whole forest.
Out in front, friend. Keep those roots planted and close it out.
You've got the lead. Finish it clean and it's yours.
Flight Night winner, right here in the woods! Every bird in the canopy is singing!
Ha! Flight Night champion! I'm naming the tallest pine after you, friend!
You own the top branch now! Treehouse keys are yours, champion!
What a night in the woods! Higher than the hawks, and the crown is yours!
The rival climbed a little higher tonight. Come back, and we'll climb again.
Ha, the woods keep score in seasons, not nights. The forest saw what you've got.
Alright, the rival took this one. Rest up, the hoop will be right here.
Flight Night goes to the rival tonight. Next time, we shake the whole canopy together.
Splits! Like a spider in the ferns!
Ha! Packing up the picnic already?
Whoa, there's a bear loose in these woods!
Telling us the rim's just a bird's nest!
Reaching for the top branch! Love it!
Pass it over. Next climber's up!
Swap seats, friends. Your turn in the clearing.
Player one, up into the branches!
Controller to player two! Let's go!
That's the duel! Top of the tree, winner!
Player one takes the duel! Highest branch in the forest!
Ha! Player two wins it! The forest saw that!
A tie! Ha, side by side, like twin pines.
Even all the way! Roots tangled together. Run it back?
